risk_model.name: XGBoost breakdown-risk classifier
risk_model.validation: time-based split: train before 2024-12-01, test on 2025

fuel_anomaly.rule: km/l below 0.81 x the vehicle's median of its previous 15 trips

health_formula: Health = 100 x (1 - 30-day breakdown risk) - 5 per overdue critical service, limited to 0-100.
safety_formula: Safety = 100 - 35 x harsh-braking events per 100 km, limited to 0-100.
performance_formula: Performance = 50 x distance vs the median driver (capped at 1) + 50 x fuel efficiency vs the vehicle's rated km/l (0 at 70%, full at 100%).
data_note: The fleet data is simulated (2023-2025); results show the method, not real-fleet accuracy.
